test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of July 2023, who is the governor of Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anandiben Patel**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anandiben Patel** has been serving as the governor of Uttar Pradesh since July 2019.
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** is the first female governor of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Anandiben Patel has previously served as the Chief Minister of Gujarat.
 
• Her tenure as governor includes a focus on education and health initiatives within the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The role of a governor in India includes overseeing the administration of the state and acting as a representative of the President of India.
 
• Governors have the power to grant pardons and reprieves, and they play a crucial role in the legislative process of the state.
 
• Governors can also recommend the President's rule in the state if they believe the state government cannot function according to constitutional provisions.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India, making the role of its governor particularly significant.
 
• The governor's responsibilities also include ensuring that the state government acts within the framework of the Constitution.
